parameters.help_en:
The general switch type.
You can obtain this parameter from the SwitchId response parameter of the [ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~) and [ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~) operations
parameters.help_zh:
通用开关类型。
通过[ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~)、[ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~)接口的响应参数SwitchId可以获取该参数
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

TargetDefault.description_en:
Specifies whether the configuration takes effect by default. Valid values:

add: Takes effect by default for newly added hosts.
del: Does not take effect by default for newly added hosts
TargetDefault.description_zh:
默认是否生效。取值：

add：新增主机默认生效。
del：新增主机默认不生效

TargetSyncStatus.description_en:
The synchronization status. Valid values:

sync: The modification is being synchronized.
valid: The modification has taken effect
TargetSyncStatus.description_zh:
同步状态。取值：

sync：修改正在同步。
valid：修改已生效

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
